input.question: How can I go to sleep extremely hungry/thirsty yet wake up and not feel the hunger/thirst at all?
input.ground_truth: After the energy of the food you consumed is used up, your blood sugar drops and the body enters a fasting state. The liver releases small doses of glucose by breaking down glycogen to maintain your blood sugar (in your case while sleeping). So when you wake up your blood sugar is at the right level and you don't feel hungry.
